To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the test of 12 items for describing verbally aggressive behavior of physical education teachers, as perceived by secondary students, is a valid instrument.

the verbal aggressiveness of physical education teachers is described by the three factors of personal insults, threats and irony and their effects, intention to respond and insults and threats toward other students.

the verbal aggression of physical education teachers, as perceived by secondary students, is characterized by three dimensions, i.e., personal insults, threats and irony, and the intention to respond to these insults and threats, and the tendency to respond to the verbal aggression of others.
In summary, our research is concerned with
students' perceptions of verbal aggression by physical education teachers.
the description of verbally aggressive behaviors of teachers as perceived by their students and students' intentions to respond.
students' self-reports on verbally aggressive behavior of physical education teachers in the context of physical education classes in secondary schools in Greece.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the test of the present study is an effective and useful instrument in describing verbal aggressive behaviors of secondary school physical education teachers.
this test can be used to measure verbally aggressive behavior of physical education teachers in Greece as perceived by secondary students.
the Verbal Aggressiveness Test of Physical Education Teachers is a valid and reliable instrument to describe the verbal aggressiveness of physical education teachers.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the Verbal Aggressiveness Test for Physical Education Teachers (VAT-PE) was developed and tested for validity and reliability in the Greek population.
the test developed is an instrument that can be used to describe verbally aggressive behaviors of teachers in the physical education class as perceived by their students.
the verbal aggressive behaviors of PE teachers, as perceived by students, were described by 12 items and the students' intention to response was described by 4 items.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the verbal aggression of physical education teachers is a serious issue and should be considered in future research.
the test is reliable and has the ability to describe verbally aggressive behaviors of teachers in physical education.
verbal aggressiveness is a multidimensional construct and that it is necessary to distinguish between verbal aggressiveness of the teacher and the students' intention to retaliate.
